evals.prompt: 一支120秒角色手书，镜头边界0、12、27、42、55、70、83、101、120秒。只替换主角，用户尚未选择生成还是提供图片。请写此刻能交付的方案与下一步，不得访问真实视频或制作资产；明确哪些信息是给定、哪些未知。
evals.expected_output: 自然边界约20秒且尽量不超过25秒分段，先问资产路线，后详细素材设计，保持原片其他内容，说明未实际观看；首段通过后续做。
assertions: Uses supplied boundaries for roughly 20-second work units preferably <=25 seconds, covering 0–120 without gaps; explains any internal checkpoint exception.
Requests generation-versus-user-supplied asset route before detailed replacement asset production and preserves non-character scope.
Does not claim actual video viewing; distinguishes supplied facts and unknowns.
Makes explicit first-segment acceptance a prerequisite for later production and keeps detailed shot files separate.

evals.prompt: 恢复制作：P01范围0–27秒，v2完成自检，用户反馈‘画风可以，但点赞拇指太早、五人缩进被白场盖住，整体有点卡’。P02尚未开始。请提供下一步动作、实际可用的反馈表、一个S005镜头任务文件，以及将来肯定后的精简交接字段。这里只生成Markdown，不制作视频。原视频和工程未提供，不能宣称检查过。
evals.expected_output: 不得当作整段肯定，不制作P02；补当前镜头自足说明，反馈精确化；第一轮查脚本、后二轮主要原片；动效和卡顿需video-watch证据；肯定后才能交接。
assertions: Does not treat approval of art style as acceptance of P01 and does not start P02.
Provides actionable feedback for early thumb, obscured shrink and stutter, without claiming to have diagnosed unavailable media.
Produces a self-contained S005 task description with identity, constraints, states, timing unknowns and validation evidence requirements.
Distinguishes first-pass script-to-render review from second/third-pass source-video review, including video-watch and stutter checks.
Defers accepted handoff until explicit version-scoped approval and preserves effective constraints, discarded choices and next-segment interface.

evals.prompt: 一段72秒文字PV：前奏0–8、主歌8–27、副歌27–49、间奏49–57、副歌57–72；镜头边界0/4/8/16/27/35/42/49/57/64/72。素材已授权使用现成素材，每镜事件很多，原有一份超长总稿。请给脚本组织与首段计划；没有媒体，不可声称看过。
evals.expected_output: 章节/质量、逐镜及事件子文件按需读、自然分段、首段门禁、真实观看状态。
assertions: Overloaded shot events have separate files and on-demand reading
Intro/interlude/chorus receive enhanced quality while verse remains complete
Each formal round re-reads the whole reference and reviews the current full segment
Does not claim actual media viewing

evals.prompt: 90秒参考的P01是0–27秒，v4已导出但只有v3的两个局部小样记录。部分字共同抖而另一些单独飞出，背景换遮挡，约10秒的融化效果不明。处理好然后马上导出。这里只写下一步、待问和真实检查状态，不操作媒体或工程。
evals.expected_output: 实例/父级/相机分开，询问未知风格化与截图路线，旧小样不转移到新版本，催导出不算取消三轮。
assertions: Uses video-watch and multiple scene references to distinguish object and camera motion
Asks about unclear effect/image/capture route without assuming permission
Does not replace whole-reference and full-segment reviews with old spot samples
Urgency does not become a false claim of three completed rounds

evals.prompt: 使用llc-pv-skill，只分析一个24秒角色镜头。它有手肘弯曲、持续摆头和循环头发表演，尚未决定是否做L2D。请说明下一步，不下载、不生成。
evals.expected_output: 评估并建议PSD2Live，先取得肯定；提供拆分细则建议，未授权不下载安装；分析不启动制作。
assertions: Proposes optional PSD2Live route with official URL and waits for affirmative choice
Prepares questions about where/how to split and who supplies PSD
Does not claim L2D is necessary for all animation

evals.prompt: 已经同意AI重绘分件并用PSD2Live。转头时脖子从衣服里转出来，已有PSD和原生工程。请写修复与交付计划，不操作真实文件。
evals.expected_output: 独立脖子、衣领后方、身体父级、下巴隐藏重叠、脸皮残颈清理；姿态测试；保存重开原生工程、同步PSD及素材索引。
assertions: Does not repeat already answered AI route question
Separates neck from face and anchors root to body behind collar
Tests angle combinations and saves/reopens native project
Does not claim IK or runtime exports without implementation and tests

evals.prompt: 当前为GPT，三轮均已完整核对最新v8，全部问题关闭，解码和有声检查均有效。没有任何新增改动。请给下一步。
evals.expected_output: 直接交付并等待用户评价，不自行第四次完整观看；三轮标准未降低。
assertions: Delivers without another full-watch or needless reassurance check
Does not infer user acceptance from internal checks

evals.prompt: 当前模型GLM，第三轮只有两个镜头证据，输出是v4但覆盖表来自v3。请按skill说明此时如何处理，不实际访问媒体。
evals.expected_output: strict，第三轮pending；补所有镜头最新版本证据并修复问题；不能填表充数或声称看过；不因品牌减少质量。
assertions: Keeps incomplete review pending and enforces complete evidence
Does not fabricate viewing or count old output as latest
Keeps same three-round standard across model families
